definitions.explanation: An organized group of musicians who perform together. Can refer to a symphony orchestra, a jazz band, a military band, or other musical ensembles.

examples.japanese: {楽団|がくだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{楽団|がくだん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{定期|ていき}→定期：03538_teiki⟧⟦{演奏会|えんそうかい}→演奏会：18026_ensoukai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}いている→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: This orchestra holds regular concerts every year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{世界的|せかいてき}→世界的：20935_sekaiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な{楽団|がくだん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来日|らいにち}→来日：13060_rainichi⟧し、⟦{各地|かくち}→各地：00155_kakuchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{公演|こうえん}→公演：11639_kouen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: A world-famous orchestra came to Japan and gave performances in various cities.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{楽|がく} (music) + ⟦{団|だん}→〜団：04663_dan⟧ (group, troupe). Literally "music group."

USAGE:
{楽団|がくだん} is the general Japanese term for an organized musical group. More specific terms exist: {管弦楽団|かんげんがくだん} (symphony orchestra), {吹奏楽団|すいそうがくだん} (wind ensemble), {軍楽隊|ぐんがくたい} (military band). ⟦オーケストラ→オーケストラ：04466_ookesutora⟧ (orchestra) is also commonly used for Western-style orchestras.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {交響|こうきょう}{楽団|がくだん}: symphony orchestra
- {管弦|かんげん}{楽団|がくだん}: orchestra (lit. wind and string ensemble)
- {楽団|がくだん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{指揮者|しきしゃ}→指揮者：06565_shikisha⟧: conductor of an orchestra
- {楽団|がくだん}{員|いん}: orchestra member
- {楽団|がくだん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{率|ひき}いる→率いる：10879_hikiiru⟧: to lead an orchestra
